preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is a positive integer.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(N, int) and N >= 2 for N in test_cases_N)
preconditions.description: For each test case, N is an integer at least 2.

preconditions.expression: all(all(isinstance(x, int) and 1 <= x <= 10**9 for x in A) for A in test_cases_A)
preconditions.description: Each element in the sequence A is an integer between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.
The sum of N over all test cases does not exceed 2*10^6.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == N - 1 for line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line contains exactly N-1 space-separated integers.

postconditions.expression: all(all(isinstance(int(val), int) and int(val) >= 0 for val in line.split()) for line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: Each integer in the output is non-negative.

postconditions.expression: all(all(min_insertions_for_K(A, k) == int(output_lines[i].split()[k-2]) for k in range(2, N+1)) for i, A in enumerate(test_cases_A))
postconditions.description: For each test case i and each K from 2 to N, the (K-1)-th integer in the output equals the minimum number of insertions required to ensure no subsequence of length at least K exists where every adjacent pair has GCD > 1.
